# Code generated from the LinkML model

This directory holds the output generated with [LinkML generators](https://linkml.io/linkml/generators/index.html)
from the schema in `src/go_standard_annotation_schema/schema/go_standard_annotation_schema.yaml`.

Each generator should output to a dedicated subdirectory named after the generator.

Only this README.md file should be committed to the repository. All other files are generated and should not be committed or edited directly.
